Here's a broad survey of what Weights & Biases offers, mapped against what your autopipe dashboard already has and what's missing:

## W&B Features vs. Your autopipe Dashboard

| Feature | W&B | Your autopipe Status | Gap |
|---------|-----|------------------------|-----|
| **Runs Table** | Sortable, filterable, groupable, column-configurable, tag editor, color-by-metric | Basic table with search + status filter | Configurable columns, grouping, tags, color-by |
| **Run Comparison** | Side-by-side params, metric deltas, parallel coords, scatter matrix, diff viewer | `RunCompare.tsx` with params + metrics + diffs | Parallel coordinates, scatter matrix, config diff, trend overlays |
| **Workspace / Charts** | Panels: line, scatter, bar, histogram, parallel coordinates, confusion matrix, media grid, custom queries | ❌ Not started | Panel system, chart library integration, metric time-series |
| **Sweeps** | Bayesian, random, grid search with run orchestration | `POST /experiments/{id}/trials` generates trial configs | Sweep agent, visualization of search space, hyperparam importance |
| **Artifacts** | Model files, datasets, code snapshots with lineage graph | `Artifact` table exists, no UI | Artifact browser, lineage visualization, storage backend |
| **Media Logging** | Images, audio, video, 3D, tables logged per step and browsable | ❌ Not started | File storage, serving, media gallery UI |
| **System Metrics** | GPU / CPU / memory / disk / network per step | ❌ Not started | Metrics collector, system metrics model, charts |
| **Reports** | Markdown docs embedding panels, runs, code | ❌ Not started | Report CRUD, markdown editor, panel embedding |
| **WebSocket Streaming** | Real-time metric curves and logs as runs execute | WS channels exist but streaming metrics not wired | Stream metric deltas and logs from executor to frontend charts |
| **Alerts & Drift** | Alert rules on metrics, drift detection, notifications | `DriftReport` + `Alerts` models exist | Alert creation UI, notification bell, alert history page |
| **Tags & Notes** | Per-run tags, notes, descriptions | No tags/notes fields | Add to model/schema/UI |

---

## What I'd Recommend Building Next

Ranked by impact for an ML experiment tracker:

### 1. **Metric Time-Series + Workspace Charts** (highest impact)
The single most important missing piece. W&B's workspace is what makes it indispensable — you create panels that plot metrics (loss, accuracy, etc.) over steps, with line charts, scatter plots, and histograms.

**What to build:**
- A `MetricLog` model: `{run_id, metric_name, step, value, timestamp}` (append-only time-series)
- Executor pushes metric logs during step execution
- Workspace page with configurable chart panels (Recharts or ECharts)
- Panel types: **Line Chart**, **Scatter**, **Bar Chart**, **Parallel Coordinates**
- Save workspace layout to DB

### 2. **Runs Table Enhancement** (quick wins)
- Column visibility toggle (show/hide config keys and metric keys as columns)
- Group runs by config key (e.g., group by `learning_rate` to see averages)
- Tag editing inline (add/remove tags on runs)
- Color rows by a metric value (heatmap on accuracy column)
- Export table to CSV

### 3. **Artifact Browser** (medium lift, high value)
Your backend already has an `Artifact` model. Build a tree-view UI for browsing artifacts per run, with download links and lineage (which run produced which model file).

### 4. **Real-time Metric Streaming** (nice-to-have)
Instead of polling, stream metric values via the existing WebSocket so charts update live as a run is executing.

---

Which direction do you want to go? I'd suggest starting with **#1 (Workspace Charts)** since it's the biggest gap vs. W&B, or **#2 (Runs Table enhancements)** if you want quicker visible improvements.
